title: Custom Client Management App — From Idea to Launch in Two Weeks
excerpt: A full-stack client management application built and deployed in just two weeks, replacing manual spreadsheet workflows.
challenge: An entrepreneur managing a growing client base was drowning in spreadsheets, sticky notes, and scattered email threads. Client information was duplicated across tools, follow-ups were missed, and there was no single source of truth for project status. They needed a custom solution — fast.
solution: We designed and built a full-stack client management application in two weeks. The app features a clean dashboard for managing contacts, projects, and tasks with real-time status tracking. We integrated automated email reminders for follow-ups and built a simple reporting view to track revenue per client. The entire system was built with a focus on speed and simplicity — no unnecessary complexity.
results: Fully functional app delivered in 14 days
Eliminated 5+ hours of weekly manual tracking

testimonial.quote: Webvise developed my client management app in just two weeks. The app has been fast, stable, and highly performant from day one. A true business asset.
testimonial.author: D. Dittmer
